correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs both substitutions from the printed Alexander polynomial. On t>0 the Cayley variable satisfies |u|<1; the exact lower bound for E_m and upper bound for the subtracted term force strict positivity. On t<0 the normalized polynomial is exactly a difference of squares minus one; the finite hyperbolic sum makes the relevant product strictly increasing from 0 to infinity, yielding one simple root below -1. Reciprocity gives exactly one reciprocal root in (-1,0). All quantifiers cover every integer \(m\ge2\).
